'''April 2001 Pleasanton tournament (14 April)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Pleasanton, California on 14 April 2001. [[Michael Mendoza]] won it. It is known from Kyle Ishimaru's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2070">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-14-pleasanton-4-14-01-2nd-againd2070/ pleasanton-4-14-01-2nd-again], DeckTech (Kyle "Psyokid" Ishimaru, 14 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-14-pleasanton-4-14-01-2nd-againd2070/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 14 April 2001
* '''Site:''' Pleasanton, California
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 16
* '''Winner:''' [[Michael Mendoza]]
